{{Quote|The prince is in danger! Quickly, I must save the prince!|An RA-7 protocol droid|<ref name="SC3" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] individual was a '''prince'''.<ref name="SC3" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the [[pirate]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] searched for the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] in a [[Unidentified droid repair shop|droid repair shop]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]]. He was unsure which droid was SM-33, and so activated multiple droids, including an [[Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Jod Na Nawood)|RA-7 protocol droid]], to check their identities. After activating the [[RA-7 protocol droid|droid]], it stated that the [[prince]] was in danger and that it must quickly save them. It then walked past Na Nawood and told him they must go that way, then repeated that they must save the prince. However, the droid was unable to see and stumbled around the room as Na Nawood ignored it and continued searching for SM-33, who he eventually found.<ref name="SC3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prince was mentioned in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC3" /> which aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref>
